visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views. Nine main room pairs, two jog pairs and two return pairs on each floor, alternating mint doors and cream windows, balcony rails, external stairs, wreath, tan parapet and white canopy are coherent with the selected Qualla photographs. The freestanding yellow Lorraine oval and five MOTEL roundels remain visible from both sides after closing the sign geometry. Rear museum interface is deliberately plain and documented; ground foundations cover the preserved coarse terrain slope.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared viewer frames including the north-up geographic overlay. Corrected the draft heading and located the motel frontage on the separately mapped west balcony polygon within the combined museum envelope. Shared concrete, sandstone, painted metal and roof bindings load with metric UVs. The courtyard and sign face west-northwest; flat fixture tests transforms and unloading, while portable and context captures show the independent terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected nineteen final frames: twelve light/distance/mode combinations, front, back, silhouette and four forced detail levels. The corrected authored skyline has 738 triangles and preserves the long two-storey motel, return and tall sign; district retains room rhythm, railings and readable sign blocks. Street and closeup retain full source detail. An earlier 1058-triangle skyline failed and its captures were discarded; only the final passing generation is approved. Surrounding houses are synthetic style context, not Memphis parcels. No physical-device frame rate is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: The mapped balcony feature 35185917602225 identifies the west-facing preserved motel frontage independently of combined museum feature 35184467221497. The main facade spans about 42.57 m with a jog and short northern return; the nine-metre rear closure is an interpretation inside the museum envelope, not a model of the whole museum. Heading -106.67 degrees makes +X south-southwest and +Z west-northwest. The museum donor-brick map is schematic and was explicitly rejected for geodetic alignment. Preserved 4225 Terrarium samples use the front courtyard reference [0,8] and 78.5267 m composite host datum. Foundation closures extend to -3.8 m across the observed -3.443004..0.018893 m footprint range; front platform and sign foundations extend to -1.2 m. Generalized map and coarse terrain are not surveyed dimensions; footprint suppression remains off.

fidelityReview.scope: Preserved motel rooms, balcony, stairs, courtyard sign and rear closure; modern museum and opposite rooming house excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Accepted as an original medium-fi preserved motel exterior using two inspected local Qualla courtyard/sign photographs plus a local wider courtyard view. Individual room pairs, return, canopy, balcony, stairs, air conditioners, memorial wreath and sign distinguish this building. The modern museum and rooming house across the street are excluded. Hidden rear closure, exact room spacing, small lettering and ornamental sign script are interpretations. Historic vehicles, interiors and exact surveyed detail are outside scope. Reference photographs are not embedded or redistributed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current hash-bound levels pass strict triangle/material/download limits and were visually inspected. The final explicitly authored skyline has 738 triangles, district is reduced within its 4000-triangle cap, and street/closeup preserve full source geometry.

geometryValidation.notes: Targeted source regeneration, normal import verification, current-LOD validation and strict medium-fi audit passed for the final build. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass. Terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi preserved motel exterior and sign; modern museum envelope, interiors, historic cars and neighboring buildings are outside scope.

Protomaps frontage and separate balcony polygon control location and alignment. Room widths, wall depths, roof heights and sign position are photographic estimates. The museum donor map is schematic and is not used as geodetic coordinates.
Hidden rear is a simplified attachment surface. Fine sign typography, room numbers, flowers and hardware are simplified. Photos remain local Qualla references and are not embedded.
Independent coarse host terrain is retained for contact review; it is not a survey. No footprint suppression is requested for the combined museum polygon.
